name: Mahlon
bio: Mahlon is one of Naomi and Elimelech's two sons, and, according to the genealogy in chapter 4, the husband of Ruth. He dies in Moab along with his father and brother, years before the main action of the book takes place. Boaz's later redemption of the family's land and his marriage to Ruth are specifically done to "raise up the name of the dead" upon Mahlon's inheritance, so his family line continues through others even though he himself never appears speaking in the story.
